title: Padangushtasana

sequence.action: Stand up straight, inhaling deeply through the nostrils.
Jump the legs half a foot apart, reach down and take hold of the big toes, lift head and chest fully, knees straight.
Draw in the lower abdomen, head between the two knees, knees straight. Stay, doing puraka and rechaka as much as possible.
Slowly lift the head, fingers still holding the big toes.

while_holding: Draw the lower abdomen in and hold it tightly.
Rechaka and puraka slowly and as much as possible.
benefits: Padangushtasana dissolves the fat of the lower abdomen, and purifies both the kanda, or egg-shaped nerve plexus in the anal region, and the rectum.
